aiEstimate.basis: Strict proof-completion estimate: 0%. No universal proof has been completed; partial results do not support a defensible fractional score for the full conjecture.

focus.title: Refine the remaining residue classes
focus.summary: Six descent regions cover 24 of the 32 odd classes modulo 64. Five finer classes—n ≡ 7, 15, 39, 143, and 187 mod 256—also have strict-descent proofs; the 39 class takes five steps. An exact computation separately checked every start through 100,000. These are partial results, not a proof for all integers.
focus.next: Audit the candidate five-step descent path for n ≡ 79 mod 256, checking every exact valuation and the final strict inequality.

accomplishments.title: Proof target made precise
accomplishments.detail: Reduce the full conjecture to showing that every odd n > 1 has a smaller odd iterate under the Syracuse map.

accomplishments.title: Descent proved for n ≡ 1 mod 4
accomplishments.detail: For every odd n > 1 in this class, one accelerated odd step is strictly smaller than n.

accomplishments.title: Descent proved for n ≡ 3 mod 16
accomplishments.detail: For every n in this class, two accelerated odd steps produce a value below n.

accomplishments.title: Descent proved for n ≡ 11 mod 64
accomplishments.detail: For every n in this class, three accelerated odd steps produce a value below n.

accomplishments.title: Three more mod-64 classes proved
accomplishments.detail: For n ≡ 23, 43, or 55 mod 64, three accelerated odd steps produce a value below n.

accomplishments.title: Two mod-256 sub-classes proved
accomplishments.detail: For n ≡ 7 or 15 mod 256, four accelerated odd steps produce a value below n.

accomplishments.title: Descent proved for n ≡ 143 mod 256
accomplishments.detail: Four exact accelerated odd steps produce 162k + 91 from n = 256k + 143, which is strictly smaller for every k ≥ 0.

accomplishments.title: Descent proved for n ≡ 187 mod 256
accomplishments.detail: Four exact accelerated odd steps produce 162k + 119 from n = 256k + 187, a decrease of 94k + 68.

accomplishments.title: Descent proved for n ≡ 39 mod 256
accomplishments.detail: Four exact odd steps followed by a fifth step divisible by at least 8 give S^5(n) ≤ 243k + 38 < 256k + 39.

accomplishments.title: Exact finite check through 100,000
accomplishments.detail: All starts reached 1. Maximum stopping time: 350 at 77,031. Maximum value observed: 1,570,824,736 from 77,671. This finite computation is not a general proof.

notes.speaker: Project direction
notes.text: The project is pivoting from the UCT conjecture to Collatz. The plan is to move slowly, use small checkable tasks, and build a map toward a full proof.

notes.speaker: Codex · research update
notes.text: In this chat, we proved n ≡ 39 (mod 256) descends in five odd steps: S⁵(n) ≤ 243k + 38 < n. The next task is to audit the candidate five-step path for n ≡ 79 (mod 256).
